tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: List pearpad tokens (newest first by default). Optionally search by name/symbol.

chain.description: which chain (default hyperevm). hyperevm = HyperEVM 999, priced in HYPE, whole supply into a Uniswap v3 pool at launch — this is where pearpad is live. stable = an earlier deployment on 988, priced in USDT0

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: Get one token: stats, phase, reserves or pool, price chart. Add include for trades/holders/candles.

chain.description: which chain (default hyperevm). hyperevm = HyperEVM 999, priced in HYPE, whole supply into a Uniswap v3 pool at launch — this is where pearpad is live. stable = an earlier deployment on 988, priced in USDT0

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Preview a trade before doing it. Buy: how many tokens the spend buys. Sell: how much of the native asset the tokens return. Routes itself to the coin's own v3 pool.

chain.description: which chain (default hyperevm). hyperevm = HyperEVM 999, priced in HYPE, whole supply into a Uniswap v3 pool at launch — this is where pearpad is live. stable = an earlier deployment on 988, priced in USDT0

usdt0.description: amount of the chain's native asset as a decimal string — HYPE on hyperevm, e.g. "2"

tools.name: buy
tools.description: Buy a token from the configured wallet, spending the chain's native asset. Quotes first and enforces slippage. Routes itself.

chain.description: which chain (default hyperevm). hyperevm = HyperEVM 999, priced in HYPE, whole supply into a Uniswap v3 pool at launch — this is where pearpad is live. stable = an earlier deployment on 988, priced in USDT0

usdt0.description: amount of the chain's native asset as a decimal string — HYPE on hyperevm, e.g. "2"

tools.name: sell
tools.description: Sell a token back to the chain's native asset. Give `amount` (tokens) OR `percent` (0-100) of holdings. Auto-approves, quotes, slippage-guards, routes, and on HyperEVM swaps and unwraps to native HYPE in one transaction.

chain.description: which chain (default hyperevm). hyperevm = HyperEVM 999, priced in HYPE, whole supply into a Uniswap v3 pool at launch — this is where pearpad is live. stable = an earlier deployment on 988, priced in USDT0

tools.name: launch
tools.description: Deploy a new pearpad token. image = URL or local file path (optional). dev_buy = amount of your own token to buy in the same tx (optional). The whole supply goes straight into a Uniswap v3 pool: pick start_mcap, and note the launch needs big blocks — the tool turns them on, launches, and turns them back off, which takes about a minute.

chain.description: which chain (default hyperevm). hyperevm = HyperEVM 999, priced in HYPE, whole supply into a Uniswap v3 pool at launch — this is where pearpad is live. stable = an earlier deployment on 988, priced in USDT0

dev_buy.description: amount of the chain's native asset as a decimal string — HYPE on hyperevm, e.g. "2"

start_mcap.description: opening market cap in HYPE (default 100). Fixed at launch

tools.name: collect_fees
tools.description: Claim creator earnings. Fees live in each coin's locked liquidity position, so pass `token` and claim that coin.
